shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone slab
human/anthropomorphic figure with arms and hands rendered
horizontal registers or bands dividing the surface
band of small repeated motifs beneath a larger figural scene
vertical upright slab format with roughly rectangular outline
justification: Both are upright stone slabs organised into stacked horizontal registers, with a larger figural scene above and a zone of smaller repeated profile motifs (animals/signs) below, and both include profile birds and human-limbed figures. The manner differs sharply, however: A is a thick, rounded, sculptural relief with irregular, boldly modelled beasts on a rough weathered block, whereas B is a flat, finely and evenly incised panel with a smoothly dressed rounded-top surface and regimented rows of standardised small signs.
